presentation.fullstack: And I work as a Full Stack Developer
presentation.paragraph1: After a rich, varied and diversified career path, I decided to specialize in the field of computer science and more particularly in web development and application design. Passionate about the world of entrepreneurship and new technologies, I continuously learn and evolve according to the required skills and market demand.
presentation.paragraph2: I design, develop and optimize web applications, from idea to realization through to production deployment. I dedicate time to self-training and constantly adapt to innovations and emerging new technologies. One of my objectives is therefore to aim to exploit those that prove relevant to successfully carry out the missions entrusted to me.
presentation.paragraph3: Therefore, I wish to contribute to ambitious and transformative projects, alongside committed companies that share strong values.

context.title: Project Context
context.ecosystemQVMD:
As part of an apprenticeship within the Blue Soft Group, I work in multi-project mode following agile methodology (SCRUM type) either in TMA or in the form of 1 or 2 week sprints depending on the project.

The organizational processes are part of a DevOps approach.

Ecosystem is a public authority-approved eco-organization. Its objective is to connect professionals in order to promote the recycling and donation of all types of waste through the organization of collection.

This operation thus allows materials to be revalued by finding them a use and giving them a second life when possible.

Application development for connecting holders and service providers in the form of 2-week sprints.
context.makeSense: Collaborative application developed to improve decision-making between different institutional actors.
context.wildRent: End-of-training project at Wild Code School, developed in a team of 4 developers.
context.myCrit: Web application developed during an internship at BlueSoft Group to facilitate temporary job search.
context.eurowatt: Professional energy management project developed in collaboration with the BlueSoft team.
context.virtuelMetArt: Virtual art management application developed during DWWM training using ViteJS and TailwindCSS.
context.franceTrivia: First training project, interactive quiz on general knowledge in France developed in JavaScript.
context.blogProject:
Personal blog project developed to share articles and ideas.

Self-taught project mainly in JavaScript using a REST API.
context.louisVuitton: Collaborative e-commerce project developed in a team at BlueSoft Group using Sharepoint, a Microsoft CMS solution.
